title: save / reopen / stale
commands: invoke -> readback: project uuid + schematic flag/wire/device + PCB designator pose
sha256 of the project file before/after
observations: After close --destroy and reopen of the same copy, the project uuid was stable and the net flag A2PROBE_VCC, the wire A2PROBE_NET, the placed device and the moved PCB component (DC1 +50/+50) were all found again.
The project file sha256 changed from 824f6dcc... (source copy) to 4be11c20... after the writes, proving the save reached disk.
The source fixture stayed byte-identical (sha256 unchanged) - all writes happened on the temp copy only.
Primitive ids are not stable across sessions; the reopen readback matches by net name/designator/proximity, not by primitiveId.
risks: saved:true still requires the reopen readback before claiming persistence
no stale-read token from the CLI: freshness is caller-managed
reopen timing needs the same project-load poll as W01
